product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI unifies contact-center data and uses AI to automate quality assurance, coaching, performance management, and customer insights for enterprise contact centers and BPOs.
product_one_liner.notes: https://www.amplifai.com/resources/amplifai-platform-overview describes unified contact-center data, AI-recommended actions, automated QA, coaching, performance management, and customer analytics for enterprise contact centers and global BPOs.

pricing_page.notes: The reviewed homepage at https://www.amplifai.com/ exposes demo-based sales rather than a pricing link. https://www.amplifai.com/pricing returned only a redirect response, not plans or pricing content. Redirect handling leaves some uncertainty.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer logo wall on https://www.amplifai.com/ names both The Home Depot and FanDuel. | named_customers.0: The Home Depot appears on the homepage customer logo wall. | named_customers.1: FanDuel appears on the homepage customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: The public company profile reports 168 employees as of August 31, 2026, while https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/229527-28 reports 170. Both place the company in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: https://www.amplifai.com/about explicitly labels its Plano address as the headquarters. | hq_country: https://www.amplifai.com/about identifies the headquarters in Plano, Texas. The company profile also explicitly identifies the country as United States.

founded_year.notes: The company's historical announcement explicitly says 2016, and PitchBook agrees: http://amplifai.com/blog/making-people-better-ai-startup-amplifai-raises-3-9m-to-accelerate-market-growth and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/229527-28. A company launch announcement dated September 2017 also predates the conflicting 2018 founding claim in its later funding release. The conflicting claims prevent high confidence.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index at https://www.amplifai.com/blog contains contact-center research, buyer's guides, product news, coaching guidance, and CX analysis. It did not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how AmplifAI is built.

public_docs.notes: The reviewed homepage navigation and footer at https://www.amplifai.com/ exposed no public docs or help-center link. The available hub at https://learn.amplifai.com/amplifai-101 is marketing-oriented thought leadership rather than product documentation, and attempted docs/help subdomains yielded no readable documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The reviewed current careers index at https://www.amplifai.com/careers lists a Senior .Net Full Stack Developer role, with no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Self-hosted GPT-OSS 120b; its security FAQ also names LLaMA.
model_provider.notes: The platform solution guide identifies the currently self-hosted model as GPT-OSS 120b: https://email.amplifai.com/hubfs/2026%20Assets/Solution%20Guides%20-%202026/AmplifAI%20Solution%20Guide%20-%20Platform%20Overview.pdf. The security FAQ separately names internally hosted LLaMA at https://www.amplifai.com/trust-security-compliance. The wording preserves that distinction rather than assuming both models serve every deployment.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: https://www.amplifai.com/trust-security-compliance explicitly claims these four compliance standards. PCI DSS is excluded because the page instead says 'PCI Security Standards Council Compliant' without explicitly naming PCI DSS. These are public company claims, not independent verification of certification. | compliance_certs.0: The trust page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 2 compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The trust page explicitly names ISO 27001 compliance. | compliance_certs.2: The trust page explicitly claims HIPAA compliance. | compliance_certs.3: The trust page explicitly claims GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company explicitly calls the financing Series B, accompanied by a credit facility: https://www.amplifai.com/blog/amplifai-raises-33-7m-to-power-high-performing-human-teams-and-ai-agents-driving-the-future-of-customer-experience. | funding_date: The company announcement is dated September 23, 2025, and the funding history identifies that same date as its latest round: https://www.amplifai.com/blog/amplifai-raises-33-7m-to-power-high-performing-human-teams-and-ai-agents-driving-the-future-of-customer-experience. | funding_amount_usd: The announcement at https://www.amplifai.com/blog/amplifai-raises-33-7m-to-power-high-performing-human-teams-and-ai-agents-driving-the-future-of-customer-experience states $33.7 million in Series B funding and a credit facility. The amount is the announced combined financing, not a separately disclosed equity-only amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 23, 2025 financing announcement falls within the requested 18-month window: https://www.amplifai.com/blog/amplifai-raises-33-7m-to-power-high-performing-human-teams-and-ai-agents-driving-the-future-of-customer-experience.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: http://amplifai.com/jobs/sales-development-representative explicitly says it is hiring an outbound SDR and provides an application link. The posting has no closing notice, but its absence from the current careers index creates freshness uncertainty.

launched_6mo.notes: The reviewed index at https://www.amplifai.com/blog did not establish a qualifying launch within the requested six-month window. The explicit platform-launch announcement located was dated September 20, 2017: https://www.amplifai.com/blog/amplifai-launches-new-platform-to-drive-ai-enabled-employee-development. Confidence is low because newer partnership/integration entries lacked verified launch dates.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Leslie Goodwin's profile identifies a Vice President of Client Integration role at AmplifAI starting May 1, 2026, inside the requested 12-month window: https://linkedin.com/in/leslie-goodwin-2b7659100.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: http://amplifai.com/jobs/sales-director-western-us names HubSpot as preferred CRM experience. https://www.amplifai.com/integrations names Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Zendesk, and SAP Service Cloud. The latter are integration signals, not proof that AmplifAI uses each internally. | crm_stack_signal.0: The sales-director job posting names HubSpot as preferred CRM experience. | crm_stack_signal.1: The integrations page explicitly describes Salesforce data flowing into AmplifAI. | crm_stack_signal.2: The integrations page explicitly describes Microsoft Dynamics 365 case and customer data. | crm_stack_signal.3: The integrations page explicitly describes a Zendesk integration. | crm_stack_signal.4: The integrations page explicitly describes SAP Service Cloud and CRM records feeding AmplifAI.
